'''Echrhin Isdan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] living among the [[Myyydril]] tribe within the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]].

He asked an adventurer exploring the caves to gather ten smooth stones from the river and pond outside the cave. When the spacer returned, Isdan gave him a [[Mystical stone|mystical glowing stone]] that would teleport the spacer from anywhere in the caverns back to [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].

==Behind the scenes==
Echrhin Isdan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|Rage of the Wookiees]], the second addon to [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. He could be found in the Myyydril village in the Myyydril Caverns, where players could talk to him to start a simple quest. The player had to go outside the caverns and search for stones in the area around the cavern entrance. The reward for the quest was a mystical stone that could be used in the caves to teleport back to [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. It spared players the long way back through the caves and Kkowir Forest area, where vehicles could not be used.
